_note: No indefinite articles anywhere. 'a apple' vs 'an apple' would make the carrier text ungrammatical for vowel-initial words, which is a property of the word rather than of its membership, and it would show up in the geometry as a real difference between words for a reason that has nothing to do with the experiment.
